column1: # AMD GPU only. Selected by $GPU in bootstrap.sh, not by machine.
# NB: there is no libva-mesa-driver or mesa-vdpau row here and their absence is
# deliberate - both were folded into `mesa` upstream and no longer exist as
# packages. Adding them back trips the "not in any repo" warning in
# NB: the 32-bit halves are not optional on a machine that runs Steam. A
# missing lib32 Vulkan driver does not error - the loader silently falls back
# to llvmpipe and the game renders on the CPU at single-digit FPS. That is the
# exact silent-substitution failure this repo exists to catch, so doctor.sh
# asserts the ICD is RADV and not llvmpipe.
